transcription_medium: Existing primary PDF text extraction, Sections 2.1-2.3, Example 3.3 and Example 6.2; the extracted maximum amplitude was corrected against PDF page 20, not guessed.

operator.domain: edgewise H2 and continuous common vertex values; sum of towards-vertex derivatives zero
operator.sign_map: Implementation flux is minus source flux at each vertex. A homogeneous zero condition is unchanged.
operator.zero_mode: Use f_e(x)=a_e+d_e x at k=0; do not substitute k=0 into a degenerate sine coefficient basis.

pumpkin.published_eigenbasis: One common cos(pi x) and E-1 zero-vertex sin(pi x) modes with edge coefficients summing to zero

split_tree.long_arms: v0->v1 and v0->v3, each length a=1/2
split_tree.fan_stems: v0->h_plus and v0->h_minus, each length epsilon in (0,1/2)
split_tree.fan_edges: m edges h_plus->p_j and m edges h_minus->n_j, all length b=atan(A/(m F))/pi
split_tree.stem_function: +sin(pi x) or -sin(pi x), with x outgoing from v0
split_tree.long_arm_function: 0 for this selected eigenfunction, not for the complete eigenspace
split_tree.perturbation: Lengthen every fan leaf edge by delta>0; do not lengthen long arms or stems
split_tree.scope: Reproduce this published family and a finite baseline instance only. No universal no-bridge existence result is asserted.

uniform_doubling.status: supervisor-suggested operator input, independently checked here; not a published hot-spot resolution
uniform_doubling.operation: Replace every original edge by two distinct parallel edges of the SAME original length, sharing its endpoint vertices; retain standard Kirchhoff conditions
uniform_doubling.not_equivalent_operation: Partial doubling or length-preserving unfolding has different weights or edge lengths
uniform_doubling.full_matching: Use continuity at every edge endpoint and one Kirchhoff row at every vertex, including both copies. No division by sin(k L_e).
